testcase.name: All supplied incidents, tasks and report settings satisfy domain rules
Store-local time converts to an exact UTC instant
Timezone conversion round-trips for each supported zone
Nonexistent DST local time is rejected
Ambiguous DST local time is rejected rather than guessed
Invalid calendar dates and normalized-but-invalid ISO timestamps are rejected
DST reporting day spans 23 hours at spring-forward
DST reporting day spans 25 hours at fall-back
Handover includes source-local event time and exact UTC time
Report has no eight-record cutoff and retains high-priority older open case
Old resolved and future records are excluded; prior unresolved records carry over
Reporting period is inclusive at start and exclusive at next midnight
Corroborated evidence cannot be asserted without actual references
References from a different store cannot qualify the observation
Closure requires qualified evidence, reviewer, finding and disposition
Review retains original facts and appends attributed outcome and correction
Reopening keeps prior closure in history and clears active resolution time
Incident escalation requires a recipient
Task review records comparison and requires recipient when escalating
Independent concurrent additions survive replay even with identical Lamport order
Concurrent same-version reviews are detected and retained as conflicts
Reset generation rejects a stale operation rather than restoring pre-reset data
Reset starts a new generation while retaining settings in prior event history
Malformed incident event is rejected before replay
Unknown enum and missing timestamp cannot pass validation
CSV fields use identical header schema to generated samples
CSV quoting preserves embedded commas, quotes and newlines
Formula-leading, whitespace-leading and full-width formula characters are neutralized
Sample discount arithmetic and return discrepancy are internally consistent
Sample dispatch approval precedes matching exit and all compared fields match
